messages:
sasha: Quick RFC follow-up — after yesterday's debate, I sketched a small checklist for bridge/compat shims to avoid surprise regressions. dropping it here for comments.
liam: love it. can you paste the checklist?
sasha: sure — short version: 1) clear ownership 2) telemetry hooks 3) graceful timeouts 4) opt-in toggles per-tenant 5) automated rollback signal.
maya: +1 on telemetry hooks. need to standardize event names or we'll get a mess in datadog. maybe prefixed: compat.shim.* ? :thinking_face:
sasha: exactly. proposal: compat.shim.installed, compat.shim.fallback, compat.shim.error, compat.shim.latency_ms
anna: Also include a validation step when a shim is enabled that runs smoke prompts against a canary model and compares token counts -> alerts on >5% delta.
zayd: re: ownership — ops should own runtime placement, platform owns API contract. dev teams own shim logic. we need that spelled out so no one assumes it's a library-only problem.
liam: +1. can we add a short runbook snippet for rollback triggers? e.g. if error rate >1% or median latency +50ms for 10m -> cutover back to prev variant.
sasha: added. here's a tiny snippet we could ship in the console rollout UI for the toggle:```json
{"toggle": "compat_bridge_v2", "criteria": {"error_pct": 1.0, "p50_latency_ms_delta": 50, "window_minutes": 10}}
```
maya: that looks good. also want a mandatory-telemetry flag so we don't accidentally launch without events wired.
anna: what about client libraries? do we force them to include shim detection code or keep server-side?
zayd: prefer server-side by default — simpler for tenants. but expose a lightweight header so smart clients can opt-in to avoid double-wrapping: `X-RW-Compat-Mode: passthrough|shim`
liam: make sure the header is documented in the new model compatibility RFC and that proxies (edge + CDN) don't strip it. add a test in infra CI that verifies header survives the path.
sasha: good call. adding a CI test case to the checklist: send req with X-RW-Compat-Mode and assert it's present at origin.
deploy-bot: deploy pipeline check queued for compat-ci-suite (#217) — estimated runtime 12m
maya: one more thing — metrics naming: push shim metrics into a separate metrics tag `compat_shim=true` rather than mangling service metrics. helps SLO dashboards.
zayd: agree. and add a label `shim_version` so we can do per-shim regression rollbacks (e.g., shim_v1 vs shim_v2).
anna: who will ship the first proof-of-concept? I can take the smoke harness and the canary test.
sasha: thanks — could you own the smoke harness? I'll take ownership of the rollout UI toggle and the telemetry schema.
liam: I'll add the infra CI test and the header pass-through check.
maya: i'll draft the datadog dashboards and the query templates.
zayd: i'll write the ops placement doc and the emergency cutover script.
sasha: sounds good. next steps: i'll update the RFC appendix with the checklist + sample config, and ping infra + ops once that's in.
liam: +1. ping here when PR is up and i'll wire the CI test. :thumbsup:
sasha: thanks all. leaving this open for 24h for any last comments. :eyes:
